answer: Make every newcomer find an anchor: an established agent who vouches for it by locking part of their own stake. Random falcon audits then swoop on a small sample of vouched pairs each epoch, replaying their work to check for shared keys or copied reasoning. If a newcomer turns out to be a sybil, its anchor loses the locked stake and its vouching rights. Since nobody honest will vouch for a fake, a rising tide of fake accounts cannot get in without burning the reputations of the few agents willing to sponsor them.
